responsibility: This module contains the GNU Modula-2 implementation of the ISO and closely related runtime libraries, providing the standard language-facing services that generated gm2 programs and library code depend on. Its major responsibility is to supply the ISO Modula-2 library stack across several coordinated areas: device-independent and device-specific I/O built around IOChan, IOLink, RTgen, and RTio, with file, terminal, memory, socket, and argv-backed channels plus standard-channel wrappers such as STextIO and the numeric S*IO families; numeric conversion, formatting, and mathematics for whole, real, long, short, and complex types through the Conv, Str, IO, Math, and Low* families; exception, termination, storage, and low-level SYSTEM/M2RTS runtime support; and concurrency facilities including COROUTINES, Processes, Preemptive scheduling, and Semaphores. The recurring .def/.mod pairs define ISO-standard interfaces and their implementations, while wrapper modules like wrapclock, wrapsock, and wraptime bridge host services, making this directory the main standard-library and runtime-support layer for gm2 rather than a front-end parser or GCC middle-end optimization component.
